targets.name: GitHub Pages
targets.deployRegion: Global CDN (Fastly); origin region not selectable
targets.referenceDescription: GitHub's own Pages marketing site, hosted on GitHub Pages
targets.notes: Controlled from launch: the HostBench test page is deployed from the separate varshith/hostbench-probe repo so site rebuilds never touch it.

targets.name: Cloudflare Pages
targets.deployRegion: Global edge; origin region not selectable
targets.referenceDescription: Cloudflare's Pages Plugins demo index (plain HTML, ~0.5 KB) on the pages.dev default domain

targets.name: Vercel
targets.deployRegion: Global edge; static assets served from CDN
targets.referenceDescription: Vercel's official Astro starter template demo (static HTML, ~5 KB) on the vercel.app default domain

targets.name: Netlify
targets.deployRegion: Global edge; static assets served from CDN
targets.referenceDescription: Netlify's official Astro platform starter demo (static HTML, ~6 KB) on the netlify.app default domain

targets.name: Render
targets.deployRegion: Static sites served via Render's CDN (fronted by Cloudflare)
targets.referenceDescription: Render's official sveltekit-static example (render-examples org, static HTML, ~1 KB) on the onrender.com default domain

targets.name: Railway
targets.referenceDescription: Railway's own documentation site (Next.js, served by Railway; custom domain because Railway has no stable vendor demo on up.railway.app)
targets.affiliateProgram: Railway referral program (15% of referred spend for 12 months)
targets.notes: Dynamic Next.js page, not a static file; treat TTFB as indicative of Railway's edge plus an app response.

targets.name: Fly.io
targets.deployRegion: Fly anycast edge; app region(s) chosen by Fly for debug.fly.dev
targets.referenceDescription: Fly's official debug echo app (dynamic, ~0.5 KB) on the fly.dev default domain
targets.notes: Dynamic app, not a static file.

targets.name: DigitalOcean App Platform
targets.referenceDescription: DigitalOcean's documentation site, served by App Platform (x-do-app-origin header); custom domain because no stable vendor demo exists on ondigitalocean.app
targets.affiliateProgram: DigitalOcean referral program (10% of referred spend for 12 months)

targets.name: Firebase Hosting
targets.deployRegion: Global CDN; origin region not selectable
targets.referenceDescription: Firebase's demo project (Flood-It sample, static HTML, ~6 KB) on the web.app default domain

targets.name: AWS Amplify Hosting
targets.deployRegion: CloudFront CDN; origin region not published
targets.referenceDescription: AWS Amplify's documentation site (static Next.js export on Amplify Hosting, large page ~300 KB); custom domain because amplifyapp.com subdomains are per-app
targets.notes: Large page inflates download/total time; compare TTFB, not total.

targets.name: Deno Deploy
targets.referenceDescription: Deno's own Deploy dashboard shell (static HTML, ~0.4 KB) served by Deno Deploy

targets.name: GitLab Pages
targets.deployRegion: GitLab.com infrastructure (GCP us-east1); fronted by Cloudflare
targets.referenceDescription: GitLab's official plain-html Pages example (static HTML, ~0.6 KB) on the gitlab.io default domain

targets.name: Surge
targets.referenceDescription: Surge's own public stats endpoint (JSON, ~0.4 KB) on the surge.sh default domain
targets.notes: Surge does not support HTTP/2 (Globalping aborts an HTTP2 request with "HTTP/2 is not supported by the server"), so this target is requested over HTTPS/1.1.

targets.name: Koyeb
targets.deployRegion: Koyeb global load balancer; backend region per app
targets.referenceDescription: Koyeb demo app (ws-Chat, ~8 KB HTML) on the koyeb.app default domain; bare demo subdomain, presumed vendor-owned
